## What changed\n\n✅ **Scalper Profitability Optimization v3**\n- New rules engine with stricter entry filters (min $50k liquidity, max $150k mcap)\n- Aggressive profit taking: +2.5% net target, -3.0% hard stop\n- Real momentum detection: +1.5% min, 60% buy ratio, 12+ unique buyers\n- 7-minute max hold to avoid bag-holding\n- Accurate 1.2% friction modeling\n\n✅ **Resume Controls**\n- New `/scalp_resume` Telegram command\n- Web dashboard Resume/Pause buttons\n- Manual pause/resume anytime\n- Auto-resume at midnight with daily limit reset\n\n✅ **Auto-Resume Scheduler**\n- Checks every 5 minutes\n- Auto-resumes both paper trader & scalper on new day\n- Resets daily loss limits automatically\n- Sends Telegram alerts\n\n## Root cause\n\nPrevious scalper version had:\n- Weak entry filters → too many losing trades\n- No profitability focus → unrealistic targets\n- No resume mechanism → manual restarts required\n- No daily auto-reset → missed opportunities\n\n## Expected improvements\n\n| Metric | Improvement |\n|--------|-------------|\n| Win Rate | ⬆️ Better filtering removes garbage trades |\n| Avg Win | ⬆️ +2.5% realistic target |\n| Hold Time | ⬆️ 7 min max (exits before rug) |\n| Stalls | ⬆️ Auto-resumes daily |\n| Control | ⬆️ Manual resume/pause buttons |\n\n## Files changed\n\n1. `paper-trader/momentumScalperRules.ts` - NEW: Core profitability rules\n2. `paper-trader/momentumScalper.ts` - UPDATED: Uses new rules engine\n3. `worker/scalpResume.ts` - NEW: Resume/pause handlers\n4. `worker/paperAutoResume.ts` - NEW: Auto-resume scheduler\n5. `components/ScalperControls.tsx` - NEW: Web dashboard buttons\n6. `styles/scalperControls.css` - NEW: Button styling\n\n## Deployment\n\n- ✅ No breaking changes\n- ✅ Fully backward compatible\n- ✅ Auto-resume on deploy\n- ✅ Ready for production\n"
